class VeraGrid.Gui.ProceduralGrid.procedural_grid.ProceduralGridWindow(app: SimulationsMain, parent=None)[source]

Bases: QDialog

SystemScaler GUI

accept_result() → None[source]

Apply the previously previewed result to the application. Does nothing if no successful preview is currently held on the instance (Accept should be disabled in that case, but we guard against accidental double-clicks).

For the CatalogueOptimizationOnly method there is no synchronous preview: we close the dialog and delegate straight to the existing application handler which launches the optimization through the session and reports its own warnings / progress.

Returns:

None.

preview() → None[source]

Validate inputs, run the expansion engine and draw the resulting topology on the embedded plot. Stores the engine result on the instance so that accept_result() can apply it without recomputing.

Returns:

None.
